5:77.text: ! Exceed not the limits in your religion
other than the truth, and do not follow the vain desires of people who went astray before and who misled many, and strayed

5:78.text: Those among the Children of Israel
who disbelieved were cursed by the tongue of Dâwûd
and were ever transgressing beyond bounds.

5:79.text: They used not to forbid one another from Al-Munkar
which they committed. Vile indeed was what they used to do.

5:80.text: You see many of them taking the disbelievers as their Auliyâ’
. Evil indeed is that which their ownselves have sent forward before them; for that
Allâh’s Wrath fell upon them, and in torment they will abide.

5:81.text: And had they believed in Allâh, and in the Prophet
and in what has been revealed to him, never would they have taken them
; but many of them are the Fâsiqûn

5:82.text: Verily, you will find the strongest among men in enmity to the believers
the Jews and those who are Al-Mushrikûn
and you will find the nearest in love to the believers
those who say: "We are Christians." That is because amongst them are priests and monks, and they are not proud.
